spans.s:
The affix घञ् comes after the verb वृ preceded by नि when the sense is that of grain.

Terms: घञ्

And The affix ण as well as अप् come after the verb अद् 'to eat' when the उपसर्ग नि is in composition.

Terms: अप्

The affix अप् comes optionally after the verbs 1. गद् 'to speak' 2. नद् 'to sound' 3. पठ् 'to read' 4. स्वन् 'to sound' when the उपसर्ग नि is in composition with them.

Terms: अप्
